title: [review] message.rs:597: TransitInfo E-flag not validat
description: TransitInfo::from_bytes always expects 20 bytes and reads parent_address from data[4..20], assuming E=1 (parent present). If an attacker sends E=0 with padding to 20 bytes, garbage is accepted as parent_address. Per RFC 6550 6.7.8, E=0 means no parent address (4-byte option). The code should validate (data[0] & 0x80) != 0 or handle E=0 case.
